Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Finn Allen and Devon Conway to open for the Kiwis. Mohammad Shami to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

It is not impossible but a daunting task lies ahead for the Kiwis. The bowlers were gone for runs and the scoreboard says it. They will be a bit tired but needs someone to play an anchoring innings to take this game deep. The pitch looks good to play on. Some balls are holding and some are coming nicely on the bat. A reminder New Zealand are without Kane Williamson. Will they miss him or the likes of Devon Conway and Tom Latham step up?  We will find out soon.

A massive total by India! However, the credit goes to one man only, Shubman Gill! From the start to the end, it was the opener who made the difference. While others struggled to hang on, it didn't matter to the youngster as he continued to play his kock in his style and reached milestone after milestone. At one moment after his 150, it looked like fatigue started to get over him but he went bonkers and in the final phase scored six after six to get his double-hundred. A moment to remember for him. India putting on a show at Hyderabad. They have a massive score to play with.
Full and outside off. Yadav slices his drive to point and it falls safely. One run. India end with 349.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Length and on off. Yadav taps it to the left of the keeper for a quick single.
Glenn Phillips puts down a sitter! A sitter for his standards! Shorter and on off. Shami pulls but gets a top edge to deep square leg. He runs in from deep mid-wicket and pops it out.

OUT! SIX AND OUT! Gill walks back to a standing ovation! A deserving ovation! It was his time and he deserves this! A knock that he will remember for years! Short and on off, Gill pulls it flat and to deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips comes in flying and puts in a dive to take a superb low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Henry Shipley

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Gill putting on a show! Too full, off cutter and on off. Gill waits and luanches it high over long on for a six.
Shorter and on off, pulled to square leg and Gill will retain the strike.
Length and on off, Yadav taps it to point for one.
On middle, pulled to square leg for one.

SIX! 200 FOR SHUBMAN GILL! Cometh the hour cometh the man! What an innings! One to remember! He is reaching milestones with a biggie! That is what this young blood has! Full and on off, this is lofted over long off for a biggie. The crowd stands as they applause the knock.
SIX! This is the best of the lot! What a stroke! Fuller and outside off. Gill goes full throttle as he lofts it high over long off for a biggie.
SIX! BANG! What a shot! On the hips, this is pulled behind square leg for a biggie.
15 runs off the over! Full toss, outside off, cut to deep point for one.
Wide! Goes more wide but over the tramline. Left alone.
A widish yorker, outside off. Gill fails to jam it out.
SIX! Gill turning it on again! Short and on middle. Gill pulls it high over square leg for a biggie.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Gill putting on the after burners! Boundary after 4 overs! Length ball, around off. Gill smashes it over long on, over the leaping fielder for a six.
On a length and outside off, Yadav dabs it to backward point for a single.
Yadav retains the strike! Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
A full toss on off, guided to point.

OUT! RUN OUT! Both the batters end up at the same side! Around off, pushed to covers, Gill wants a single but Thakur was ball watching. Mitchell Santner throws it to the keeper who removes the bails and Thakur has to sacrifice his wicket here.
Very full and on middle, drilled to long on for one.
Short ball on off, Gill pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
300 comes up! Length and on middle, worked to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Gill cuts it past point for two more.
On a length and outside off, Thakur cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.

On a length and outside off. Gill looks to heave but gets a top edge to third man. The fielder tried his best to go for the catch but he falls well short. Meanwhile, near the 22 yards, Gill has taken one short. Only a single.
Short and on off, this is pulled to deep square leg for two. Henry Shipley with his long hands make a solid stop.
Length and on off, Gill keeps it out.

OUT! LBW! An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Sundar revies it. Didn't look much confident there. No bat there and the Ball Tracking shows THREE REDS. So, the extra delivery turns out to be a fruitful one for the Kiwis! On a length and around off, shaping in. Sundar was late as he tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. That was an easy decision for the umpie.
Wide! Tailing down the leg side. Sundar misses his clip.
India dealing in singles! Full and on middle. Gill heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Goes full again angling on middle. Sundar works it to cover for one.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A yorker on middle. Sundar jams it out to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Gill drives it to covers for a quick single.
Tossed up, outside off, Gill strokes it to long off for one.
Shorter and outside off, cut to deep point for a couple.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short and outside off, Gill slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Outside off, cut to point for a single.
Full and outside off. Gill stays back and pushes it to point for one.
A full toss, outside off, this is pushed back to Michael Bracewell.
Touch short and this is pulled to deep square leg for one.

SIX! 150 for Shubman Gill! He is no mood to stop! What a knock this is turning out to be! Tossed up, outside off. Gill skips down and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie. 200 looks possible for him.
Tossed up, outside off, played back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
Flatter and outside off, Sundar punches it to deep point for easy two.
Outside off, dragged to mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this is hit to long off.
FOUR! How good was that? On middle, Gill short arm jabs it to deep mid-wicket. There was a fielder standing across but hits it firmly in the gap for four. Pierces two fielders.
Outside off, cut to point for brace.
Shorter and on middle. Gill punches it wide of long on and pushes for the second. Good running.
Wide! Bowls it way outside off. Gill leaves.
Flat and outside off, Sundar pulls it past mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, pushed to long off for one.
Short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.

Not out this time! Short and on middle. Gill cuts to deep point for a couple. One of the bails came off but the replay shows there was a huge gap between Gill and the stumps. Tom Latham's gloves touch it.
Full and on off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on off, defended out.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length and on middle. Gill chips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.

OUT! BOWLED! That was an eventful delivery! On a length and around off. Pandya gets very ow to play to third man but misses and the ball seems to hit the top of off and the bails light up. New Zealand celebrates but the umpire wants to take it upstairs. UltraEdge shows no bat. The replays show that Tom Latham had his gloves behind the stumps and was deemed as bowled. Touch and go and the big screen shows OUT! The more you see the replay the more you feel the ball was well over the stumps.
Short again, Gill whacks it to long on for a single.
Around off, Pandya works it to square leg for a quick single.
Short in length and on off, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
FOUR! lucky boundary! Short of a length and on middle. Pandya bends his back and holds his bat out. The bat goes off the leading edge to fine leg for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Gill punches it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and around off, Pandya drags it to long on for a single.
Length and on middle. Pandya keeps it out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller and on off, Pandya drives it to mid off.
Outside off, dabbed to point for one.
FOUR! Already proving costly. Length ball, outside off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.

Dropped! Length ball, outside off. Gill smashes it straight back to the bowler. Henry Shipley throws his left hand out and the ball momentarily sticks but he fails to hold on. Hard one but this could prove costly.
Length ball, outside off. Gill punches it to the right of deep cover. A fine stop in the deep.
On middle, blocked out.
Full and outside off. Pandya carves it to deep cover for two more.
Full and on middle, this is pushed to long on for one.
Short of a length and on middle. Pandya plays it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and on off, Gill works it to point for one.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Boundary to start the over! Short and on off, Pandya cuts on the up and over point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off, Pandya punches it to cover for one.
On middle, kept out.
Full toss on off, pushed to mid off for one.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler. Pandya was backing up too much so had to dive back but Henry Shipley was eyeing for a throw at the batters side.
FOUR MORE! Gill is playing superbly here. Short again, this is pulled over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and on off, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Goes full and around off, driven straight to cover.
Length ball, outside off, Gill slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
This is outside off. Pandya cuts it to third man for one.
On a length and on off. Pandya keeps it out.
A single as this is hit through cover.
Length and outside off, Gill punches it to cover.
Wide! A bumper, outside off. Gill sees it go over his head.

On a length and outside off, Pandya knocks it to cover.

On off, kept out.

Around off, punched to covers for one.
FOUR! Outside off, Pandya looks to play with hard hands but gets an outside edge to third man for one.
On middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, pushed to the left of mid off for one.

On a length and on middle. Pandya clips it to square leg for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Pandya drills it to mid on.
On middle, defended out.

FOUR! Gill looking for 150 now! Fuller and outside off Gill skips down and drives it through covers. The fielder dives in the deep but in vain.
Full and on off, Pandya eases it to long off for a single.
Slightly full and angling on leg. Pandya looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. It was going down.

On off, pushed to long off for a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.

On a length and outside off, Pandya pushes it to cover.
On off, kept out.
A single as this is hit to square leg.

SIX! GILL ON 99! Santner drops it short and on off. Gill opens his body and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

Length ball, outside off, Pandya eases it to mid on.

Around off, pushed through covers for one.

On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.

Another single as Yadav works it to fine leg.
On a length and on middle. Gill glances it to fine leg for one.
Length ball, outside off, Yadav punches it to covers for one.
Full and on off, pushed to the left of mid off for one.

FOUR! Gill is different class! Full and on middle. Gill flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and on off, Yadav pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Gill prods to defend but inside edges it to square leg for one.
Tossed up on middle, Yadav eases it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Yadav dealing in boundaries! On middle, this is swept to deep square leg for a boundary.
Full and on middle, Gill eases it to long on for a single.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! Another boundary! On middle, this is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Flatter and outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Full and on off, this is driven through covers for a single.
On off, kept out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
A single as this is hit through covers for a boundary.
On off, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, guided to point for one more.
FOUR! Going down the leg side. Gill helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Yadav is off the mark! Short and outside off, Yadav punches it past point for four.
On middle, kept out.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! What a ripper from Ferguson! He bends his back and hits the hard-length, around off, nips a bit away after landing. Kishan gets on his toes to defend but gets an outside edge to the keeper who pouches it safely. Good phase by the Kiwis here.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Pushes it full and outside off, Gill drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, Gill looks to flick but gets a leading edge to cover.
A single as this is hit to square leg.
SIX! Fifty in style for Gill! He continues his good form! Gill has locked his place as an opener. Making most of the opportunity. Full and on middlle. Gill slogs it high over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Flat and outside off, Kishan punches it to cover for a single.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one.

Stumping chance missed! What a big chance! huge moment! Tossed up, outside off. Gill comes down the track to heave but misses. Tom Latham fails to pick up cleanly and till then Gill makes his way back.
On middle, Kishan defends on the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flat and on off, Blocked out.
Full and outside off, Kishan places it to point.
Shorter and outside off, Kishan guides it to point.
On the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for one.

Drinks! India will be happy with the start but they have lost two big wickets. Shubman Gill is batting superbly and Kishan has just joined him. New Zealand will hope for more wickets. They have a bit wayward but are looking good now. An interesting middle phase awaits.
This one lands outside off and turns away. Kishan looks to defend but misses.
Tossed up, outside off, Gill drives it to deep cover for one.
One more single as this is hit to covers.
Flat and on off, Gill flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Kishan pushes it to long off for one.
Around off, pushed to cover.
Fuller and outside off, Kishan punches it through covers for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, Kishan defends to cover for a quick single.
Flatter and on off, defended.

OUT! BOWLED! The man in red-hot form goes! What a delivery from Santner! This is orthodox delivery from Santner. Angles it in and targets the stumps. The ball spins very little away. Kohli tries to defend inside the line but gets beaten on the outside edge and the ball shatters the off stump. That was a superb delivery.
On the pads, helped to short fine leg.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Off the middle. Full and on middle. Gill smashes it over mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Gill tries to hit it straight, this is on middle. Gill plays off the inner half of the bat and over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
On middle, nudged to square leg for one.
FOUR! Pierces through the gap! Kohli with his first boundary! Pitched up, outside off. Kohli steps forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
12 runs off the over! Good start by India! Full and on off, Kohli works it to long on for a single.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one.
FOUR! Uses the feet! Tossed up, angling on middle. Gill skips down and hits straight down the ground to long on for four.
Tossed up, outside off, Kohli drives it to long off for one.
A single as this is hit to long off.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Strays it on the pads, Gill pulls it late and past square leg for a boundary. Played it very late.
Goes full and on middle, this is drilled to mid on.
Too full and on middle, bunted past square leg for one.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side. Gill misses his flick.
Kohli is off the mark! This is full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
Short of a length and around off, nips in. Kohli looks to flick but gets hit high on the back pad.
A bumper to welcome Kohli. He lets it go.
Virat Kohli walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! Rohit goes! Yet another start for him but fails to make the most of it. This is full and on middle at 140 clicks. Rohit tries to play through the line but was a touch early to his shot and loses his control. The ball goes high up in the air and to mid on where Daryl Mitchell takes the skier. New Zealand break the stand.
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Blair Tickner

Around off, pushed to cover.

Too full and on middle. Rohit steps across and drills it to mid on. Tickner has been disciplined.
Fuller and on middle. Rohit blocks it to mid-wicket.
Around off, Gill keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle. Gill rocks back and tucks it to md-wicket.

Flatter and around off, Rohit taps it to cover.
On middle, blocked out.
Mitchell Santner to bowl now.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to cover.
On middle, punched to mid on.
FOUR! Two in a row! 50 up! Shorter and on middle. Gill stays back and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.

Wonderful from Tickner! Keeps it around off, very close to the pole and tempts Gill to play. He tries to push but misses.
On middle, blocked out.
On off, kept out. Tidy from Lockie Ferguson.

Length ball, around off. Rohit stays back and pushes it to cover.
Length ball, outside off. Rohit punches but finds mid off this time.
Short of a length and on off, played back to the bowler.
Length and on middle. Rohit defends on the front foot.
Good start from Tickner! Length ball, outside off. Gill knocks it to cover.
On the pads again, clipped to mid-wicket.
On a length and on midde. Sharma nudges it to square leg for one more.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for a single.
Outside off, cut to point.
Wide! A bumper on middle. Gill leaves. Too many wides already from New Zealand.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Glorious drive! Pitched up, outside off, Gill leans and drives it through covers for four.
This is outside off and on the shorter side. Gill tries to chase this one but misses.
Length ball, just around off. Gill punches it to cover.
Targets the off stumps. Gill blocks it out.
Outside off on a length, Gill works it to point.
Length and angling down. Gill misses his flick and it brushes the pads on its way to the keeper.
Length ball, outside off, Sharma again makes a leave.
On off, kept out.
SIX! This is bread and butter for Rohit! He will pull this all day long! Short and angling down. Rohit pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
On a length and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
This is full and outside off, Sharma happily leaves it.
Full ball, outside off, Rohit lets it go.
Wide! Down the leg side, wided.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Lucky one! Lockie Ferguson drags his length back and serves it outside off. Gill looks to pull but gets a top edge behind the keeper for a boundary.
Lockie Ferguson serves it on a length and on middle. Gill keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off, Gill punches but finds cover.
This one slants in on middle. Gill looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Outside off, Gill leaves it alone.
SIX! All the way! What a shot! 10 off the over then! Full and outside off. Rohit lofts it over covers and it goes all the way for a biggie.
Outside off, Rohit leaves it alone.
Beauty! This one holds its line, fuller and outside off. Sharma goes for the big booming drive but misses.
Length and outside off, Rohit shoulders arms.
FOUR! Good shot! This is on the hips, Rohit waits on the back foot and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, guided to point.
On a length and on off. Gill blocks it out. Just four of the over then.
This is full and slanting on off, bit of swing. Gill defends again.
Length and on off, Gill defends.

Lockie Ferguson gets it to swing back in, length and on off. Gill defends it out.
Shorter and on the hips, Gill chips it wide of mid-wicket.
Lockie Ferguson to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! This time Rohit goes for the classical drive! Full and outside off, it is hit through covers for a boundary. Rohit is off the mark.
On a length and around off. Rohit solidly blocks it.
An outswinger, full and outside off. Rohit again makes a leave.
Tempting line but Rohit leaves! This is full and outside off. There to drive but Rohit leaves.
Fuller and slanting on middle. Rohit steps across and eases it to mid on.
Shipley goes full and on middle, Rohit pushes it to mid on.

Wide! Starts with a length ball, swinging down the leg side. Rohit misses his clip.
We are all set for action. Rohit Sharma and Shubman Gill are out to open for India. The Kiwis have taken their position as well. Henry Shipley to start with the ball.
It's time for the national anthems. It will be New Zealand's first followed by India's.

Suryakumar Yadav is up for a chat. He says he is looking forward to this tournament. Adds he tries to play according to the situation and whatever the team demands. Reckons he sometimes feels the emotions from the crowd but he remembers what he did to get all this, so he tries to remain the same.

New Zealand (PLAYING XI) - Finn Allen, Devon Conway, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham (C/WK), Glenn Phillips, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Henry Shipley, Lockie Ferguson, Blair Tickner.
India (PLAYING XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Suryakumar Yadav, Ishan Kishan (WK), Hardik Pandya, Washington Sundar, Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Mohammed Siraj, Mohammad Shami.

Tom Latham says they wanted to bat first as well, looks a good wicket. Adds they are looking forward to the series. Shares New Zealand love to play here. Informs they are playing three seamers and two spinners.

Rohit Sharma says it is a good pitch, a little dry and they want to defend the score. Adds it is critical to keep the momentum but they want to focus what is in their hands. Reckons it is nice to have a headache when there are so many players competing for a place. Shares Hardik Pandya, Shardul Thakur, Suryakumar Yadav and Ishan Kishan are playing.
TOSS - India have won the toss will BAT first!

PITCH REPORT - Murali Kartik says it is a nice colored surface, light grass. Adds batting first or batting second is immaterial. Reckons it is cold in the evening so dew will not play much part. Feels it is upto the team to choose what they want to do.

New Zelaand have rested two key players, Williamson and Southee but despite that look like a very strong team. India are without KL Rahul, and Iyer but their batting looks very balanced and in top form. Bowling too looks very strong and with the form of Siraj and Kuldeep, we should expect both teams to go hard against each other. Toss and team news coming up. With so many matches coming up with less time to recover, it shouldn't be surprising if teams shuffle their pack and test their bench regularly.

The journey to the upcoming World Cup is on and both India and New Zealand have kicked off their journey. Hello and welcome to the first ODI. India after a clean sweep against Sri Lanka face a much tougher test against New Zealand and so does the Kiwis who after winning against Pakistan look to gather momentum and build a squad for the mega event.
...Match Day...

The road to the 2023 ICC Men's World Cup continues with another three-game ODI series, this time between two in-form teams as India take on New Zealand at home. The first game of the tour will take place at the Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium in Hyderabad. India are fresh off their 3-0 drubbing of Sri Lanka which also included the record-highest victory by a margin of runs in ODI cricket in the final game of the series. The Kiwis themselves are on a high after sealing a comeback 2-1 win in the ODI series win against Pakistan in Pakistan. New Zealand are also the number 1 ranked side in the format and when these two sides met a couple of months earlier in New Zealand, the Kiwis were pretty dominant. Let's talk a bit about the two teams as India will be without KL Rahul and Axar Patel but they have recalled Shahbaz Ahmed ​​​​​​ as a like-for-like replacement for Axar. Washington Sundar is also back in the mix and Shardul Thakur too returns to the One-Day side, with keeper Srikar Bharat earning a maiden ODI call-up. There will be a toss-up between Yuzvendra Chahal and Kuldeep Yadav for game time as both have been pretty solid in recent times. New Zealand on the other hand have rested skipper Kane Williamson and Tim Southee which means Tom Latham will lead the side. Latham has an impeccable record against India but will have to lead a fairly depleted side on this tour. They will also be without Adam Milne and the pace attack will be led by Lockie Ferguson .They do have quality spinners in the form of Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi and Michael Bracewell but it will be a tough task for their batters who haven't been consistent in recent times. Both sides have quality individuals and a few inexperienced players as well but with eyes firmly set on getting the squad ready for the ODI World Cup later this year, both sets of players will be looking to put on a show and we get to watch all the enticing cricketing action. Who are you backing?
